axes.runtime: Open-source self-hosting is the main current form (1Panel-dev/MaxKB repo direct 200, pushed same day 2026-10-30; releases v2.10.8-lts 2026-10-22); one-click deployment via the 1Panel app store is on record (Fit2Cloud ecosystem); official docs live at docs.fit2cloud.com/maxkb (direct 200).
axes.local_files: In the self-hosted form data lives on your own machines (deployment docs on record) — the core difference from hosted products: knowledge-base files and chat logs all stay inside your own deployment; the commercial editions' data surface not verified item by item.
axes.background: The product's main axis is enterprise knowledge-base Q&A (RAG) + workflow orchestration + Skills + MCP tool calling (four capabilities on record in the same-day official blog); scheduling and background-execution details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: MCP tool calling is an officially stated capability (same-day blog: "supports RAG, workflow orchestration, Skills and MCP tool calling"); workflow node surfaces are on record in the docs; the concrete connector list not verified item by item.
axes.context: The knowledge base (RAG) is the core persistent knowledge surface; multi-turn context on record; cross-application memory details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: GPL-3.0 strong copyleft — derivative-distribution obligations differ from the Apache family (embedding into closed-source products requires assessing the propagation surface); two deep-synthesis algorithm filing entries on record (see the cn block: both the service-provider and the technology-supporter roles are filed); training-use toggle path not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: intranet self-hosted KB Q&A (data never leaves the domain), a China-origin open-source option with MCP tool calling and workflow orchestration, a filed-compliance narrative (two algorithm-filing entries on record). Not a fit: permissive licensing (GPL-3.0 copyleft), casual personal use (enterprise-delivery oriented).
